title: SEBI Introduces Dynamic Price Bands for Equity & Commodity ETFs (Effective Sept 1, 2026)
summary: Equity/Debt ETFs get initial ±10% dynamic price band; Gold/Silver ETFs get ±6% initial band.

blocks.title: 📰 2. 🏛️ REGULATORY BODIES NEWS
blocks.text: 🪝 SEBI Introduces Dynamic Price Bands for Equity & Commodity ETFs (Effective Sept 1, 2026). Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Equity/Debt ETFs get initial ±10% dynamic price band; Gold/Silver ETFs get ±6% initial band.
Equity/Debt ETFs: Initial dynamic band ±10%, expandable up to ±20% after 15-minute cooling off.
Bullion ETFs: Gold & Silver ETFs get initial ±6% band, expandable in 3% stages without upper/lower limits.
Pre-Open Auction: Pre-open call auction mechanism introduced for Gold & Silver ETFs.
Equity ETF initial band (±10%) vs Gold/Silver ETF initial band (±6%).
🎯 Exam Angle → Focus on statutory circular guidelines, compliance deadlines, penal provisions, and applicability thresholds across scheduled banks.
